answer: Start from the attacker's ledger: building 1,000 fake identities needs a harbor of clean introducers. Each endorser locks 100 copper for 12 epochs and backs at most 3 newcomers, so a 1,000-clone batch needs 34 clean introducers locking 3,400 units. The admission gate admits only identities on a verified referral chain, and a lantern review lights up spiral-shaped clusters, flagging density above 0.6. When forgery is confirmed, the whole chain freezes and the introducer loses backing rights for 10 epochs. At 40% detection, expected loss is 13,600 units.
